notes.title: BeanVR beta version is now open download.Play VR social together!
notes.content:
China's first VR Social application—BeanVR.  has launched a beta version, welcome to download and experience. participate in testing. become the first batch of BeanVR players.

Currently open function introduction
1. watch the video.live
2. Guardian Athena goddess game
3.3D painting function
4. Take pictures.self-timer function
5. Add friends function
6. Draw board painting function
7. Free to choose a virtual image
8. Voice expression function
9. Chinese and English bilingual switching function
10. System bulletin board. activity panel
11. Voice real-time text message board
12. chat room.360 panoramic room.live room.conference room and so on

With friends around the world online. face to face chat by VR.  play games.
watch live. Participate in various activities. enter BeanVR and encounter him or her!
